((Page 22) In the development and establishment of the oil industry in Yan'an, the palace system must fully participate. They have the technology accumulation of refining kerosene and also have funds, so they should be able to play a big role. However, everything cannot be counted on the palace system. Whether it can change the appearance of the place, the government has to take the main responsibility. However, the people of the Third New Tokyo City were not too confused. After being stunned for a moment, everyone packed up their things. , packed up his things and returned to his room or found a shelter and squeezed in. "Director, if the Japanese are arrogant, how can they be afraid of the 80th Soviet Army?" Zhu Qinglan said. If Lin Yanghao took action, he could easily come in, but if he did, how could he not alert her? Then the only explanation is that Lin Yanghao was let in by another tall man with a stern face. When Wang Luo looked over at the young man, he immediately sensed it and looked back, showing far more vigilance than ordinary people. "It was probably during the lunch break that the missing soldier disappeared." Guo Liang said. Different from the common ring-shaped wheels, the new wheels evolved by this smart armor after absorbing two vehicles were actually spherical. This can be said to be a fatal mistake. After all, he was originally in the same position as Ikari Yuantang. A certain weakness. When they looked up, everyone saw that Ao Yunzhu from the previous portrait was now vividly appearing in front of them. Since they were in Wannan District, which was not far from the Yuelaiden Hotel where Wu Xinghui worked, Wang Yiyuan thought that she would just wait for Wu Xinghui to get off work and invite him to have dinner together to complain. The night wind blew his hair from light gray to silver gray under the moonlight, and the flying hair looked like a bird with its feet tied.
